Narrow but real divergence from a near-current DolphiniOS (3,675 changed Core lines; identical generation markers to dolphin-ios). Unique in this repository: .slangp RetroArch shader chains (VideoCommon/Slang/), a cached-interpreter rewrite 480->1769 lines with inlined hot opcodes, MetalFX upscaling, and the 'Bell Audio' CoreAudio path.
8 real cores + 3 bridge-only stubs (Mango, Lychee, Durian have no System/ dir).
41 prebuilt *.libretro.framework binaries + Citra.framework; no core source in repo.

CONTRADICTION: MeloNX/LICENSE.txt is verbatim MIT (Ryujinx Team and Contributors); README.md:13,218 claims GPLv3 but no GPL text ships. Must be resolved with the author before Avalon derives from it. Bundled ffmpeg is LGPL-3.0.
or-later confirmed at PPSSPP/Core/Core.cpp:5. Common/GPU/thin3d.h:5 is MIT. 10 files inherited from 2003-era Dolphin are GPL-2.0-ONLY (see vendoredCores).

SPDX GPL-2.0-or-later confirmed (Source/Core/Core/Core.cpp:2). Newest Dolphin base of the three derivatives. Holds the iOS JIT acquisition ladder (ptrace, csops, AltServer, JitStreamer, Apple TXM) and Dolphin's AbstractGfx/AbstractPipeline/AsyncShaderCompiler abstraction, which returns 0 hits across all seven sibling projects.

STALE UNBRANDED COPY of dolphin-ios, not a fork. The string 'iCube' appears 0 times in iCube/iCube/Source, which retains 500 DolphiniOS references and ships DolphiniOS.xcodeproj. Its only unique file is an app icon PNG. All 15 generation markers put it older (STATE_VERSION 170 vs 175; SDL2 vs SDL3; RenderBase.cpp vs EFBInterface.cpp). Lacks dolphin-ios's iOS JIT code entirely. RECOMMENDED FOR REMOVAL.
Real ARM64 PCSX2 port (ARMSX2 lineage, 3804 vixl call sites). 838 SPDX headers, no GPL-2.0-only files. The repository's only NATIVE Metal renderer (GS/Renderers/Metal, 8 .metal shaders).

Vendored via the merge workflow at Libretro/genesis-plus-gx. Hosted through AvalonLibretro (Sources/AvalonLibretroGenesisPlusGX, namespaced gpgx_retro_* symbols) and GenesisPlusGXSpec (Sources/AvalonCore/Cores/GenesisPlusGXCore.swift). Integrated and tested: GenesisPlusGXCoreTests loads a ROM, runs frames, and round-trips a save state through the real, compiled core. libretro/scrc32.h, vendored alongside it, carries a non-commercial redistribution restriction and is confirmed dead code in this build -- crc32 is supplied by the system's zlib instead. See docs/ENGINEERING-MAP.md §5c.

Vendored via the merge workflow at Libretro/nestopia. A C++ core -- unlike Genesis Plus GX, its own build never hit the INLINE/bare-C99-inline trap, since C++ inline functions get proper linkage from the language itself. Hosted through AvalonLibretro (Sources/AvalonLibretroNestopia, namespaced nestopia_retro_* and nestopia_lrc_* symbols -- the latter because its own vendored libretro-common snapshot differs from Genesis Plus GX's, so both cores' internal utility symbols collided the moment both were linked into one binary) and NestopiaSpec (Sources/AvalonCore/Cores/NestopiaCore.swift). Integrated and tested: NestopiaCoreTests loads a ROM, runs frames, and round-trips a save state through the real, compiled core. See docs/ENGINEERING-MAP.md §5d.

Vendored via the merge workflow at Libretro/mgba. The only core here whose real build is full CMake, not a standalone libretro Makefile -- two generated files (flags.h, version.c) are hand-resolved instead of generated; see include/mgba/flags.h and src/core/version.c for exactly what was chosen and why. Vendors one genuine third-party dependency, inih (BSD-licensed, a few hundred lines), needed by config.c's Configuration API even though the actual INI-file-reading half of it is never exercised. Removes the Gambatte (GPL-2.0-only) blocker entirely: this is what Avalon actually ships for GB/GBC/GBA. Hosted through AvalonLibretro (Sources/AvalonLibretroMGBA, namespaced mgba_retro_* and, once a third core revealed the same per-language option-array collision already seen between Genesis Plus GX and Nestopia, mgba_lrc_* too) and MGBASpec (Sources/AvalonCore/Cores/MGBACore.swift). Integrated and tested: MGBACoreTests loads a ROM, runs frames, and round-trips a save state through the real, compiled core. See docs/ENGINEERING-MAP.md §5e.

Vendored via the merge workflow at Libretro/bsnes. GPL-3.0-only, not -or-later (LICENSE.txt: 'specifically version 3 of the License and no other version') -- not a compatibility trap the way GPL-2.0-only would be, since it is already at generation 3; see License.swift's .gpl3Only case. Unlike the other three cores, its own target-libretro build has no libretro-common dependency at all -- its utility layer is nall, its own, already namespaced under C++ namespaces -- so the namespace header only renames the 24 RETRO_API entry points. Requires C++17 (nall uses structured bindings and if-constexpr), raising the package-wide C++ standard from C++14; Nestopia's own C++ build and tests are unaffected (verified). Only the real translation units are compiled, not whole directories: bsnes's own build is a unity build where most .cpp files exist to be #included exactly once, never compiled separately -- 37 real files total (22 in sfc/processor/emulator/filter/lzma/target-libretro, 15 in the vendored SameBoy-derived gb/Core, needed unconditionally because Super Game Boy support routes through it even for plain SNES carts). Hosted through AvalonLibretro (Sources/AvalonLibretroBsnes, namespaced bsnes_retro_*) and BsnesSpec (Sources/AvalonCore/Cores/BsnesCore.swift). Integrated and tested: BsnesCoreTests loads a minimal LoROM image that satisfies bsnes's own header-scoring heuristic, runs frames, and round-trips a save state through the real, compiled core. One vendored-source patch: nall/traits.hpp's std::is_signed/is_unsigned specializations for __int128 are a hard compile error under the newer libc++ CI's iOS SDK job compiles against (which marks those traits _LIBCPP_NO_SPECIALIZATIONS) and were confirmed redundant before being guarded out -- libc++'s own intrinsic trait implementation already classifies __int128 correctly with no specialization at all. See docs/ENGINEERING-MAP.md §5g.

projects.notes: Vendored via the merge workflow at Libretro/pcsx_rearmed. GPL-2.0-or-later, verified against actual source-file headers, not GitHub's spdx_id tag. Its own Makefile.libretro forces DYNAREC=0 on platform=ios-arm64 -- the 'no JIT on iOS' decision already made upstream, same spirit as Citra's dynarmic being disabled on aarch64 -- so only the plain interpreter (psxinterpreter.c) runs; no AvalonJIT integration needed. Has a real HLE BIOS (psxbios.c): no copyrighted Sony BIOS file is required to boot. A real per-file build (not a unity build): the object list was extracted by actually running `make -f Makefile.libretro platform=ios-arm64 HAVE_CHD=0 -p -n` and reading make's own resolved OBJS/CFLAGS out of its database, the same discipline as tracing bsnes's unity build by hand. HAVE_CHD=0 (matching Genesis Plus GX's own precedent) skips compressed-disc-image support for this first cut; USE_ASYNC_GPU is left off and gpu_async.c excluded (its header's gpu_async_enabled() macro just becomes 0, so gpu.c calls the synchronous renderer path instead) after a real SIGSEGV, traced by hand (lldb's debugserver isn't permitted to attach in this environment) to the async GPU notify path on every GP1 display-mode write -- not chased further when the synchronous path avoids it entirely. The only vendored .S (real AArch64 assembly, for the GTE fixed-point math coprocessor) in this repository; confirmed SwiftPM compiles and links .S sources correctly before committing to it. One vendored-source patch: frontend/libretro.c's retro_init() self-attaches via PTRACE_TRACEME on Darwin to get JIT memory permissions without an entitlement -- meaningless with DRC_DISABLE (no dynarec linked in at all) and actively harmful in a sandboxed dev environment, where it stopped the test process outright; guarded behind !defined(DRC_DISABLE). Integrated and tested: PCSXCoreTests loads a minimal PS-EXE (homebrew executable) image built from the real EXE_HEADER format libpcsxcore/misc.c reads, enables the GPU display via a real MIPS program, runs frames, and round-trips a save state through the real, compiled core -- the frame check reads the very first retro_run() call specifically, since every one after it is a legitimate libretro duplicate-frame report once nothing new is drawn, not a bug.

vendoredCores.hazard: A no-commercial-use term is an additional restriction; GPL section 7 forbids it. These cores cannot be combined into a GPL/AGPL work.

vendoredCores.name: scrc32 (Genesis Plus GX libretro port)
vendoredCores.evidence: Libretro/genesis-plus-gx/libretro/scrc32.h:9-13 ("Redistributions may not be sold, nor may they be used in a commercial product or activity.")
vendoredCores.hazard: Non-commercial redistribution term; excluded from Avalon per GPL section 7 and the same reasoning that already excludes Snes9x and Manic EMU's gated cores. Confirmed dead code: nothing in AvalonLibretroGenesisPlusGX #includes it. crc32 is supplied by the system's zlib instead.

Plain MPL-2.0: no file under src/ios/App carries the Exhibit B 'Incompatible With Secondary Licenses' notice, so MPL section 3.3 permits distribution under AGPL-3.0 as a Secondary License with the MPL files' own notices preserved.
